section_summary.extract_value: This section details the assessment of neuroticism and extraversion using the Neuroticism and Extraversion subscales of the NEO Five-Factor Inventory. Each subscale comprises 12 items rated on a 5-point scale, with higher scores indicating higher levels of the respective traits. The internal consistencies for these measures were reported as high (Cronbach's α=0.90 for neuroticism and 0.85 for extraversion).
